questions.issue: 'Folladora' = (female) fucker; as an appliance name it's a made-up 'fuck-machine'. Basque 'kakatzailea' is a loose invention (kakatu = to fuck, colloquial).
'LavoCocino' looks like a brand-name pun (lavo + cocino = I wash + I cook); translated 'WashCook'.
'cuidadora' = caregiver / domestic care worker; kept as carer figure among the appliances (political reading: unpaid care labour).
